title: Petal-Debt Courier
text: Petal-Debt Courier delivers a perfumed invoice and pockets useful equipment while the recipient reads. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The flowers are real. So is the theft.

defeatReward.text: Petal-Debt Courier is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
